description: This source file contains a PHPUnit test class 'SanitizerTest' which tests SVG sanitization functionalities provided by the 'Sanitizer' utility class. It includes multiple test methods verifying the removal of malicious scripts and attributes from SVG XML strings, as well as correct handling of well-formed SVGs and malformed input.

classes.name: SanitizerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the SVG sanitization functions to ensure malicious content is removed and SVGs are correctly processed.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the Sanitizer instance and DOMDocument before each test.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithScriptTag
methods.description: Tests that a SVG containing a `<script>` tag is sanitized properly by removing the script element.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithOnClick
methods.description: Verifies that malicious attributes like `onclick` are removed from the SVG element during sanitization.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithAnimate
methods.description: Checks that `<animate>` tags with potentially malicious attributes are removed during sanitization.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithRegularSVG
methods.description: Ensures that a well-formed SVG without malicious content remains unchanged after sanitization.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithBadlyFormattedSVG
methods.description: Confirms that improperly formatted SVGs throw a `SanitizerException` indicating bad formatting.
